decisions.statement: A character is filed under the slug the reading gave that character.
A character already filed is written again rather than filed twice.
What a character already states and this filing does not is left as it is.
A character's claims are landed in the file beside its page rather than in the page.
Two claims alike in every field are one claim.
A claim is filed under the chapter whose reading gathered that claim.
A chapter is known by the label its page carries as a title.
A reading whose chapter no page carries is passed over rather than guessed at.
The first and last chapter a character has are the chapters its claims reach.
A character whose claims reach no chapter states no first and no last.
Characters are landed a batch at a time rather than all in one landing.

definition: a world's characters filed from what a reading of its chapters gathered
